title: Add Document Isolation Policy
body: This PR integrates the `Document-Isolation-Policy` and `Document-Isolation-Policy-Report-Only` HTTP response headers (formerly incubated in https://wicg.github.io/document-isolation-policy/) into the HTML Standard, allowing individual documents to opt into cross-origin isolation without requiring COOP and COEP across the entire browsing context group. Companion Fetch PR: [whatwg/fetch PR](https://github.com/whatwg/fetch/pull/1981) ### Summary of changes (organized into 4 commits) 1. **Header, policy container, and inheritance:** - Adds definitions for the various Document Isolation Policy struts and headers. - Adds Document Isolation Policy to the PolicyContainer for inheritance management. - Handles inheritance for workers (Dedicated Workers inherit DIP from their creator, all other workers ignore it). 2. **Agent cluster cross-origin isolation keying:** - Replaces the browsing context group's cross-origin isolation mode with an agent cluster cross-origin isolation key. 3. **Same-origin, cross-agent-cluster synchronous access checks:** - Because Document Isolation Policy can place two same-origin Document inside the same browsing context group into different agent clusters, updates synchronous access checks to also require matching agents. 4. **cross-origin isolated capability:** - Exempts documents with an isolating Document Isolation Policy from requiring the "cross-origin-isolated" permissions policy feature (so cross-origin widgets can isolate themselves without embedder `allow="cross-origin-isolated"`). ### Checklist - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium (implemented) * WebKit / Gecko: … - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/master/html/document-isolation-policy (currently `.tentative`; follow-up WPT PR will remove `.tentative`) - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: … * Gecko: … * WebKit: … * Deno: N/A * Node.js: N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: … - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use. - [ ] IANA registration request for `Document-Isolation-Policy` and `Document-Isolation-Policy-Report-Only` *** /acknowledgements.html ( diff ) /browsers.html ( diff ) /browsing-the-web.html ( diff ) /document-lifecycle.html ( diff ) /document-sequences.html ( diff ) /index.html ( diff ) /indices.html ( diff ) /nav-history-apis.html ( diff ) /semantics.html ( diff ) /webappapis.html ( diff )
